decision.observation: Car at 3 mph on the right verge, with white posts and a cream/red barrel directly to its right. Second and third dots light-blue (off-road), red X lit. Tarmac lies left of the car and bends left up-screen; a big puddle sits on the left of the lane ahead.
decision.hypothesis: The long throttle hold pushed the car right onto the verge again. Tarmac is to the left on this frame and the lane curves left, so a short throttle-left hold should remount the lane before it hits the post cluster.
decision.memory: In this pine stretch, a full 1.0s hold tends to drift the car right off the lane. Dots lighting 2-3 blue is a dependable off-road flag here.
